question: In modern society, with more families having both parents working, there is debate over whether grandparents or childcare centres offer better care for children, especially considering the increasing demands of remote work and urban living.
essay:
People hold conflicting views about childcare when parents working. While a number of people believe that close relatives may care for their children, I firmly hold the view that childcare organizations are the better choice.

On the one hand, family members can provide care for children for many reasons. One of the main causes is that it helps parents save costs. When close relatives such as grandparents care for their children, parents can decrease some costs such as study fees, uniform expense and so on, especially in financially disadvantaged families. As a result, they may spend money on their need. Another plausible explanation is that children who cared for by closed relative tend to receive more love and attention. To explain, family members often have a close emotional bond with children and spend more free time on taking care of children. As a result, it helps children feel loved and emotionally cared.

On the other hand, I strongly believe that children should be looked after at childcare environments. Firstly, children centres provide a more professional environment for young children. These centres often follow structure educational programs that are designed to support children’s early learning. Consequently, children can develop basic skills such as reading, communication and so on. The second is that children can develop more comprehensively in babysitting environment. This is because they are exposed to a wide range of activities that support both their physical and mental development. Moreover, activities such as sports, music, and art can enhance their creativity and overall well-being.

In conclusion, while acknowledge the validity of family members’ care of children, I personally believe that children organizations are the better option.

expected.reference: People hold conflicting views about childcare when parents working.
